description: Butch Fife Realtorswas established in 1995 by Melvin (Butch) Fife who has 30 years experience in the real estate business. He is referred to as the "landman" by folks in North Texas.
We are a full service Real Estate Company and specialize in land and farms and ranches.
We have two locations to better serve your real estate needs. Our associates can serve you in Texas and Oklahoma.
Our commitment to the profession of real estate is re-iterated in our clients' satisfaction and ability to serve our clients efficiently.
We look forward to serving any of your real estate needs. Please call us for any additional information.

description: Positioned along Bennett Road in one of Grayson County’s fastest-growing corridors, this exceptional tract offers an outstanding opportunity for investment, future development, or private rural living. Ideally located between Sherman and Howe, the property is just minutes from the expanding Texas Instruments campus, GlobalWafers, Coherent and Nvidia partnership, and the recently announced H-E-B in south Sherman. Surrounding growth continues to strengthen the area’s long-term potential, with nearby developments including Centurion American’s Cottonwood community, Shepherd’s Place master-planned development, and Riverside Homebuilders’ residential project immediately east of the property. A small creek borders the eastern property line, adding natural character and privacy. Conveniently located near Sherman’s new retail hub with quick access to U.S. Highway 75, this versatile tract combines an excellent location with strong future upside, making it well suited for residential development, a long-term investment, or the construction of a private estate.
